headline: Managing your subscription—billing questions answered simply
universal_truth: Clear understanding of your account enables you to focus on learning, not logistics
fun_facts: You can manage your subscription anytime from your account settings
We offer multiple billing options to fit different preferences
Our support team handles billing questions within 24 hours
discussion_questions: Do you understand your current subscription status?
What billing questions do you have?
Is your subscription working well for your needs?

hook.script: Let's talk about the practical stuff—your subscription and billing. Clear understanding here means you can focus on what matters: learning. I'll walk you through the basics.

cliff.script: Billing can seem complicated. What's the simplest way to understand your account?
cliff.prompt: What should I know about billing?

options.text: Your account settings show everything—your current plan, next billing date, payment method, and options to change or cancel; everything is self-service and transparent
options.response: Exactly. Your account settings are the hub. View your plan, update payment, change subscription—it's all there. No mysteries, no hidden processes.
Support can help, but most things you can do yourself in account settings. It's designed to be self-service...

fact1.title: Viewing Your Plan
fact1.script: In account settings, you'll see your current plan, when it renews, and what it includes. Everything is laid out clearly. No surprises.

fact2.title: Making Changes
fact2.script: Want to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel? It's all in account settings. Changes take effect at your next billing cycle. No phone calls required—it's designed for simplicity.

fact3.title: Getting Help
fact3.script: If something isn't clear or isn't working, email hello@curiouskelly.com. Describe your issue and include your account email. We respond within 24 hours.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Understanding your account gives you control. Take a moment to review your settings so the business side is clear and you can focus on learning.

outro.script: Check your account settings now if you haven't recently. Make sure everything looks right. And if you have questions, we're here to help.

growTrack.title: Account Check - Review Your Settings
growTrack.activity: Go to your account settings. Review your current plan, next billing date, and payment method. Make sure everything is as expected. Bookmark the settings page for future reference.
